name: ForgePad
description: The coin of ForgePad, the launchpad on Robinhood Chain. 1B fixed supply: no team allocation, no presale, no taxes, no owner. It opens on ForgePad's bonding curve at a time fixed in the contract, for everyone at once, its creator included. At graduation the v4 pool opens at the curve's last price and is locked for good. FORGE gets 10% of every coin's trading fees and half of every launch fee: part buys and burns FORGE, the rest pays stakers. The split is a constant in the contracts.
